collection.title: Mitsubishi Colt Convertible 2006 to 2009 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Mitsubishi Colt Convertible 2006 to 2009 model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 11" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment.
